raceway diagnostic

Pond Health Check

Always-on readings up front. Switch on anything below that you can actually test — the score only uses what you turn on.

Always checked

01 · Culture colour

Match against a scoop held up to daylight, not through the pond surface. A stronger blue-green (phycocyanin) tint is a good sign, not just deep green.

02 · pH & temperature

Optimal Spirulina growth sits around pH 9.5–10.5 and 30–35°C.

pH9.8
7.59.511.5
Temperature32°C
15°28°42°

03 · Field & scope observations

Tap what you're seeing right now — just a scoop and a scope needed.

Optional — switch on what you can test

Water chemistry

Needs a meter or test kit. Leave off if you're not testing these today.

Microscopy & growth trend

Needs a scope session or a density reading against yesterday's.

Operational

Judgement calls from watching the pond, not instruments.

Quick reference

Corrective dosing

Literature starting points for an already-running pond — jar-test on a small volume before dosing the full raceway, and rescore 24h after any correction.

N
Yellowing / low nitrateNaNO₃, 100–250 mg/L. Most common fix for chlorosis — try this before Mg or Fe.
Mg
Yellow-green persists after N correctionMgSO₄·7H₂O, 20–50 mg/L.
Fe
Yellow-green persists after N & MgFeSO₄·7H₂O, 2–5 mg/L, dosed with an equal weight of EDTA — iron precipitates fast above pH 9 without a chelator.
P
Low phosphateK₂HPO₄, 25–50 mg/L.
Alk
Low pH / low alkalinityNaHCO₃, 0.5–1 g/L per adjustment; let it mix a few hours before retesting.
Bio
Grazers / competing algaeBenzalkonium chloride, 2 ppm spot treatment — jar-test first, overdose harms Spirulina too. Follow with a pH push to 10.5–11 to discourage regrowth.
NH₃
Elevated ammoniaNo dosing — cut nitrogen input, boost aeration, dilute with fresh medium.
Field screening tool only — not a substitute for lab titration, cell counts, or contamination culturing when a crash is suspected.

1 Set Scale-Up Parameters

V(n) = V₀ × (OD_start/OD_dil) × (OD_trigger/OD_dil)ⁿ volume multiplies every time you dilute back down after growth
INPUTS
Starting Culture
L at OD
Your starter culture volume and its optical density.
Minimum Dilution OD floor — do not dilute below this
Every dilution — including the very first one from the starter — brings the culture down to this OD, never lower.
Growth Trigger OD typically 0.5–0.6
As soon as the growing culture reaches this OD, dilute it straight back down to the minimum OD above.
Desired Final Volume ⟵ auto-synced
Scale-up stops as soon as this volume is reached or exceeded.
Growth Cycle Length
days per cycle
Time taken to grow from the minimum OD back up to the trigger OD, e.g. 0.1 → 0.5.
RESULTS
⚠ Trigger OD must be higher than minimum dilution OD, or the culture never grows in volume.
